name: Jade-Crystal Tavern

rooms.benefit: Rest + extra: next social check +1 (same day)

menu.item: Miner's Set (stewed meat + black bread + ale)

rumor_pool: They dug something strange out of the mine's third level lately, and the miners won't go down anymore.
Word is someone out east found the entrance to elf ruins; the guild's already sent people to confirm it.
Crow-Eye Vance looked over a stone the other day and went white as chalk. Kept his shop shut three days after.
Father Silas of the Dawnlight Chapel often heads toward the mine in the dead of night — no one knows what for.
Jadestone's jade output has been dropping lately, and the mining company men are at their wits' end.
